WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT AVG(ra.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
       AVG(ra.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price,
       AVG(ra.avg_daily_price - cra.avg_daily_price) AS avg_excess_daily_price
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_average cra
WHERE ra.avg_daily_price > cra.avg_daily_price;
